notes.title: New Updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you to everyone who has played the game, and a big thanks to those of you who have left reviews. They've been a joy to read and extremely helpful when making adjustments. After going through the reviews, I made quite a few adjustments to the game as of this morning. 

There are a number of changes, and I've also released two new videos explaining most of the changes in depth. The videos should be visible in the community hub called "New Updates - Gameplay" and "New Updates Story". 

Please check them out if you get the chance.
Again, thank you so much everyone for playing, and please have a fantastic day!

Best,

-Kuni H-
